reports.title: Guide
reports.query:
This report provides a define.xml-style view of a study's datasets, variables, and controlled terminology against a chosen sponsor standard.

**1. Select a Study**
- Use **Filter Study** and/or **Filter subpart for** — each one narrows the other. Start typing to refresh the list.
- The **Select study version or subpart** table lists every version (and any subparts) of the study, with its DRAFT/LOCKED status. The LATEST version is listed first, followed by the other versions, most recent first. Click a TrialID or SubpartTrialID row to pick that specific study record.

**2. Select a standard**
- In **Standard selection**, click a row to choose the Sponsor Model IG and its underlying CDISC Model IG version.
- In **Select SDTM CT version**, choose the SDTM Controlled Terminology package used to resolve codelists and terms.

**3. Review datasets**
- **Datasets** lists every dataset applicable to the study, derived from the Activities and Activity Instances selected in the study's SoA.
- Click a dataset to see its variables, as defined by the chosen standard (CDISC core/type/role and applicable codelists).
- Click a variable's codelist to see its terms and the Topic Variables they apply to (Value-Level Metadata, VLM). If no terms are shown, the item is either not defined for the Activity Instances included in the study, or has no terms defined.

This report helps users understand how the study's define.xml will look, based on its SoA selections.

reports.title: Study - $neodash_study_number
reports.query:
MATCH (n1:StudyRoot)-[r1]->(n2:StudyValue) WHERE id(n2) = $neodash_studyid
    RETURN DISTINCT 'Study ID' AS label,
    n2.study_id_prefix + '-' + n2.study_number AS Value
    UNION
MATCH (n2:StudyValue)-[r2]->(n3:StudyTextField) WHERE  id(n2) = $neodash_studyid  AND n3.field_name = "study_title"
    RETURN DISTINCT 'Study Description' AS label,
    n3.value AS Value
    UNION
MATCH (n2:StudyValue)  WHERE id(n2) = $neodash_studyid
    RETURN DISTINCT 'Study Acronym' AS label,
    n2.study_acronym AS Value
    UNION
MATCH (n2:StudyValue)<-[r0:HAS_VERSION]-(n1:StudyRoot) WHERE id(n2) = $neodash_studyid
    OPTIONAL MATCH (n2)<-[:BEFORE]-(sact_before:StudyAction)
    OPTIONAL MATCH (n2)<-[:AFTER]-(sact_after:StudyAction)
    WITH coalesce(sact_before.date, sact_after.date) AS date
    RETURN DISTINCT 'Date' AS label,
    format(date, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss") AS Value
    UNION
MATCH (n2:StudyValue)<-[r0:HAS_VERSION]-(n1:StudyRoot) WHERE id(n2) = $neodash_studyid
    WITH collect(DISTINCT r0.version) AS versions
    RETURN DISTINCT 'Version' AS label,
    string.join(coll.distinct(versions), '') AS Value
    UNION
OPTIONAL MATCH (n1:StudyRoot)-[r1:LATEST]->(n2:StudyValue) WHERE id(n2) = $neodash_studyid
    RETURN DISTINCT 'Latest' AS label,
    type(r1) AS Value
    UNION
MATCH (n2:StudyValue)<-[r0:HAS_VERSION]-(n1:StudyRoot) WHERE id(n2) = $neodash_studyid
    WITH collect(DISTINCT r0.status) AS statuses
    RETURN DISTINCT 'Status' AS label,
    CASE WHEN 'LOCKED' IN statuses THEN 'LOCKED' ELSE 'DRAFT' END AS Value

reports.title: Standard selection
reports.query:
MATCH (n1:SponsorModelValue)-[r1:EXTENDS_VERSION]->(n2:DataModelIGValue)
RETURN "Select" AS Select,
n1.name AS SponsorModelIg,
n2.name AS CdiscModelIg,
n2.effective_date AS EffectiveDate,
n2.version_number AS Version;

reports.title: Datasets - Using $neodash_sponsor_model
reports.query:
// Study selection with applicable Visits and Study Activities and Grouping New Version
MATCH
  (n2:StudyValue) where id(n2)=$neodash_studyid
WITH n2
MATCH(n2)-[r2:HAS_STUDY_VISIT]->
  (n3:StudyVisit)-[r3:STUDY_VISIT_HAS_SCHEDULE]->
  (n4:StudyActivitySchedule)<-[r4:STUDY_ACTIVITY_HAS_SCHEDULE]-
  (n5:StudyActivity) where id(n2)=$neodash_studyid
// Connection between Study Activities to Library Activities and back to the Study Visits
WITH DISTINCT n5
MATCH
  (n5)-[r9:HAS_SELECTED_ACTIVITY]->
  (n10:ActivityValue)-[r10:HAS_GROUPING]->
  (n11:ActivityGrouping)<-[r11:HAS_ACTIVITY]-
  (aigv:ActivityInstanceGroupingValue)<-[:LATEST]-
  (aigr:ActivityInstanceGroupingRoot)<-[:HAS_GROUPING_ROOT]-
  (air:ActivityInstanceRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (n12:ActivityInstanceValue)<-[r12:HAS_SELECTED_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE]-
  (n13:StudyActivityInstance)
WITH DISTINCT n12
// Looking at the SDTMIG and the connected MasterModel
MATCH (n27:DataModelIGValue)<-[r28:EXTENDS_VERSION]-(n28:SponsorModelValue)
WHERE n28.name = $neodash_sponsor_model
// Display the Domain connected to the ActivityInstance
// Updated: replaced HAS_CT_TERM->CTTermRoot with HAS_CT_TERM->CTTermContext->HAS_SELECTED_TERM->CTTermRoot
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (n12:ActivityInstanceValue)-[r29:CONTAINS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]->
  (n29:ActivityItem)<-[r30:HAS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]-
  (n30:ActivityItemClassRoot)-[r31:MAPS_VARIABLE_CLASS]->
  (n31:VariableClass {uid: 'DOMAIN'})-[r32:HAS_INSTANCE]->
  (n32:VariableClassInstance)<-
    [r33:IMPLEMENTS_VARIABLE {version_number: n27.version_number}]-
  (n33:DatasetVariableInstance)<-
    [r34:HAS_DATASET_VARIABLE {version_number: n27.version_number}]-
  (n34:DatasetInstance)<-[r35:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (n35:Dataset),
  (n29)-[r36:HAS_CT_TERM]->
  (n36:CTTermContext)-[r37:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (n37:CTTermRoot)<-[r38]-
  (n39:CTCodelistTerm)
WHERE n35.uid = n39.submission_value
WITH DISTINCT n34, n35,n28
//Only get the SponsorModelDatasetInstance applicable for the model chosen (SponsorModelValue)
MATCH (n35)-[r57:HAS_INSTANCE]->(n48:SponsorModelDatasetInstance)<-[r59:HAS_DATASET]-(n28)
MATCH (n34)-[r58:IMPLEMENTS_DATASET_CLASS]->(n54:DatasetClassInstance)
RETURN DISTINCT
  n35.uid AS Dataset,
  n48.extended_domain as `Sponsor Dataset`,
  n48.label AS Description,
  n54.label AS Class,
  n48.structure AS Structure,
  "Tabulation" AS Purpose,
  "To be Specify" AS Keys,
  n34.description AS Documentation,
  TOLOWER(n35.uid) || ".xpt" AS Location;

reports.title: $neodash_dataset Using $neodash_sponsor_model
reports.query:
MATCH
  (ig_root:DataModelIGRoot)-[v:HAS_VERSION]->(n1:SponsorModelValue)-[r1:HAS_DATASET]->
  (n2:SponsorModelDatasetInstance)<-[r2:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (n3:Dataset)
WHERE n1.name = $neodash_sponsor_model AND n3.uid = $neodash_dataset
MATCH 
  (n2)-[r3:HAS_DATASET_VARIABLE]->
  (n4:SponsorModelDatasetVariableInstance)<-[r4:HAS_INSTANCE]-
  (n5:DatasetVariable)  WHERE r3.version_number = v.version
//WHERE r3.version_number=toString($neodash_sponsor_version_number)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n5)<-[r5:HAS_KEY]-(n2)
//Get any codelist linked to a SponsorModelDatasetVariableInstance
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (n4)-[k1:REFERENCES_CODELIST]->
  (cl_root:CTCodelistRoot)-[k2:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (cl_at_root:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)-[k3:LATEST_FINAL]->
  (cl_name:CTCodelistAttributesValue)

RETURN DISTINCT
  n5.uid AS Variable,
  n4.is_basic_std AS Cdisc,
  n4.label AS `Label/Description`,
  (n4.xml_datatype + " [" + n4.variable_type + "]") AS Type,
  n4.length AS Length,
  n4.display_format AS DisplayFormat,
  CASE WHEN n5.uid = 'DOMAIN' THEN n5.uid ELSE cl_name.submission_value END AS Codelist,
  CASE WHEN n5.uid = 'DOMAIN' THEN n4.term ELSE '('+cl_name.submission_value+')' END AS Term,
  n4.core AS Core,
  n4.origin AS Origin,
  n4.role AS Role,
  n4.ig_comment AS Comment,
  r3.ordinal AS Order
ORDER BY toInteger(Order);

reports.title: Codelist/Terms - $neodash_codelist
reports.query:
// First get the study-specific activity items
MATCH (n2:StudyValue)
WITH n2
WHERE id(n2) = $neodash_studyid
MATCH
  (n2)-[r2:HAS_STUDY_ACTIVITY]->
  (n3:StudyActivity)-[r3:STUDY_ACTIVITY_HAS_STUDY_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE]->
  (study_ai:StudyActivityInstance)-[r4:HAS_SELECTED_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE]->
  (ai)-[r5:CONTAINS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]->
  (aitm1)
WHERE NOT (n3)<-[:BEFORE]-() AND NOT (study_ai)<-[:BEFORE]-()
MATCH
  (n2)-[l1:HAS_STUDY_ACTIVITY_SCHEDULE]->
  (schedule)<-[l2:STUDY_ACTIVITY_HAS_SCHEDULE]-
  (n3:StudyActivity)
MATCH
  (n2)-[l3:HAS_STUDY_VISIT]->
  (vis:StudyVisit)-[l4:STUDY_VISIT_HAS_SCHEDULE]->
  (schedule:StudyActivitySchedule)
MATCH (s_epoch:StudyEpoch)-[l5:STUDY_EPOCH_HAS_STUDY_VISIT]->(vis)
MATCH
  (s_epoch)-[l6:HAS_EPOCH]->
  (context:CTTermContext)-[l7:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (ep_ct_term_root:CTTermRoot)<-[l8:HAS_TERM_ROOT]-
  (epoch_term:CTCodelistTerm),
  ()-[l9:HAS_SELECTED_CODELIST]->
  (epoch_cl_root:CTCodelistRoot)-[l10:HAS_TERM]->
  (epoch_term)
MATCH(epoch_cl_root)-[l11:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->(epoc_cl_att_root:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)-[l12]->(epoch_cl:CTCodelistAttributesValue)
WITH DISTINCT ai, aitm1, epoch_term,epoch_cl_root,ep_ct_term_root,epoch_cl
MATCH
  (ai:ActivityInstanceValue)-[l1:CONTAINS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]->
  (aitm1_dom:ActivityItem)<-[l2:HAS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]-
  (n1:ActivityItemClassRoot)-[l3:MAPS_VARIABLE_CLASS]->
  (dom_class:VariableClass {uid: 'DOMAIN'}),
  (aitm1_dom)-[l4:HAS_CT_TERM]->
  (x1:CTTermContext)-[l5:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (x2:CTTermRoot)<-[l6:HAS_TERM_ROOT]-
  (ct2_dom:CTCodelistTerm)
WHERE ct2_dom.submission_value = $neodash_dataset

// Path 1: Direct CT terms via HAS_CT_TERM
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aitm1)-[:HAS_CT_TERM]->
  (ct_context:CTTermContext)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (ct2cd:CTTermRoot)<-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]-
  (term:CTCodelistTerm)<-[:HAS_TERM]-
  (clr:CTCodelistRoot)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (clatt:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (cl_cdisc:CTCodelistAttributesValue)

// Collect path 1's candidates before path 2 runs, so the two OPTIONAL MATCH
// blocks aggregate independently instead of cross-joining into a cartesian
// product of rows (which is what made the old COALESCE silently drop a valid
// codelist match whenever another path also had a non-null value on the same row)
WITH ai, aitm1, epoch_cl_root, epoch_cl, ep_ct_term_root, epoch_term,
  collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN clr IS NOT NULL THEN {clr: clr, cl_cdisc: cl_cdisc, term_root: ct2cd, term: term} END) AS path1_candidates

// Path 2: Unit definition CT terms via HAS_UNIT_DEFINITION
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aitm1)-[:HAS_UNIT_DEFINITION]->
  (unitdefr:UnitDefinitionRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (unitdef:UnitDefinitionValue)-[:HAS_CT_UNIT]->
  (ct_context_unit:CTTermContext)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (unit_code:CTTermRoot)<-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]-
  (unit_term:CTCodelistTerm)<-[:HAS_TERM]-
  (unit_clr:CTCodelistRoot)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (unit_clatt:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (unit_cl_cdisc:CTCodelistAttributesValue)
WITH ai, aitm1, path1_candidates, epoch_cl_root, epoch_cl, ep_ct_term_root, epoch_term,
  collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN unit_clr IS NOT NULL THEN {clr: unit_clr, cl_cdisc: unit_cl_cdisc, term_root: unit_code, term: unit_term} END) AS path2_candidates

// Union all three sources as independent candidates (instead of COALESCE), then
// subset on the requested codelist, so a match on any one path is never hidden
// by a different non-null value on another path
WITH ai, aitm1,
  [c IN path1_candidates + path2_candidates +
    [CASE WHEN epoch_cl_root IS NOT NULL THEN {clr: epoch_cl_root, cl_cdisc: epoch_cl, term_root: ep_ct_term_root, term: epoch_term} END]
   WHERE c IS NOT NULL] AS candidates

UNWIND candidates AS candidate
WITH ai, aitm1,
  candidate.clr AS final_clr,
  candidate.cl_cdisc AS final_cl_cdisc,
  candidate.term_root AS final_term_root,
  candidate.term AS final_term

WHERE final_cl_cdisc.submission_value = $neodash_codelist

// Get term attributes
MATCH
  (final_term_root)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (term_att:CTTermAttributesRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (term_att_value:CTTermAttributesValue)

MATCH
  (ai)-[:CONTAINS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]->
  (aitm_topic)<-[:HAS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]-
  (aitmc_topic_r:ActivityItemClassRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (aitmc_topic:ActivityItemClassValue)-[:HAS_ROLE]->
  (:CTTermContext)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (:CTTermRoot)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->
  (:CTTermNameRoot)-[:LATEST]->
  (role_val {name: 'Topic'})
OPTIONAL MATCH
  (aitm_topic)-[:HAS_CT_TERM]->
  (:CTTermContext)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->
  (:CTTermRoot)<-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]-
  (topic_name:CTCodelistTerm)
MATCH
  (final_term)<-[:CONTAINS_SUBMISSION_VALUE]-
  (:CTPackageTerm)<-[:CONTAINS_TERM]-
  (:CTPackageCodelist)<-[:CONTAINS_CODELIST]-
  (ct_package:CTPackage)
WHERE ct_package.name = $neodash_ct_package
WITH DISTINCT
  final_clr,
  final_cl_cdisc,
  final_term_root,
  final_term,
  term_att_value,
  collect(DISTINCT {code: topic_name.submission_value, name: ai.name}) AS vlm_pairs,
  ct_package

// Group codes per originating name (instead of splitting/re-zipping two
// independently-collected lists), so a topic variable keeps only the CT
// codes that actually came from its own Activity Instances
UNWIND vlm_pairs AS vlm_pair
WITH
  final_clr,
  final_cl_cdisc,
  final_term_root,
  final_term,
  term_att_value,
  ct_package,
  vlm_pair.name AS vlm_name,
  [c IN collect(DISTINCT vlm_pair.code) WHERE c IS NOT NULL] AS vlm_codes
WITH
  final_clr,
  final_cl_cdisc,
  final_term_root,
  final_term,
  term_att_value,
  ct_package,
  collect(
    CASE
      WHEN size(vlm_codes) = 0 THEN vlm_name
      ELSE reduce(joined = '', code IN vlm_codes | CASE WHEN joined = '' THEN code ELSE joined + '/' + code END) + '(' + vlm_name + ')'
    END
  ) AS vlm_names

RETURN DISTINCT
  final_clr.uid AS ConceptID,
  final_cl_cdisc.submission_value AS SubmissionValue,
  final_cl_cdisc.name AS Name,
  final_cl_cdisc.extensible AS Extensible,
  vlm_names AS `For Topic Variable`,
  final_term_root.uid AS `Term ConceptID`,
  final_term.submission_value AS `Term SubmissionValue`,
  term_att_value.preferred_term AS `Term Name`
ORDER BY SubmissionValue, `For Topic Variable`, `Term SubmissionValue`;

reports.title: Select SDTM CT version
reports.query:
match(:CTCatalogue{name: "SDTM CT"})-[:CONTAINS_PACKAGE]->(n:CTPackage) where not (n)-[:EXTENDS_PACKAGE]->() and
toLower(toString(n.`name`)) CONTAINS toLower($input) 
RETURN DISTINCT n.`name` as value,  n.`name` as display ORDER BY toString(value) DESC LIMIT 100

reports.title: Select study version or subpart - $neodash_study_number
reports.query:
MATCH (sr:StudyRoot)-[r0:HAS_VERSION]->(s:StudyValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)<-[x0:HAS_STUDY_SUBPART]-(s_sub:StudyValue)
WITH
  sr,
  s,
  r0,
  s_sub,
  s.study_id_prefix + '-' + s.study_number AS TrialID,
  CASE
    WHEN s_sub IS NOT NULL
      THEN
        s_sub.study_id_prefix + '-' + s_sub.study_number + '-' + s.study_subpart_acronym
  END AS SubpartTrialID

OPTIONAL MATCH (sr)-[r1:LATEST]->(s)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)<-[r_b:BEFORE]-(sact_before:StudyAction)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)<-[r_a:AFTER]-(sact_after:StudyAction)
WITH DISTINCT
  s,
  s_sub,
  TrialID,
  SubpartTrialID,
  sr.uid AS StudyRoot,
  collect(r0.status) AS statuses,
  collect(r0.version) AS versions,
  type(r1) AS Latest,
  coalesce(sact_before.date, sact_after.date) AS date
ORDER BY StudyRoot, date, Latest DESC WHERE TrialID =$neodash_study_number
WITH
  s,
  StudyRoot,
  CASE WHEN s_sub IS NOT NULL THEN s.study_subpart_acronym ELSE s.study_acronym END AS acronym,
  TrialID,
  SubpartTrialID,
  format(date, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss") AS Date,
  CASE
    WHEN 'LOCKED' IN statuses THEN 'LOCKED'
    ELSE 'DRAFT'
  END AS Status,
  string.join(coll.distinct(versions), '') AS Version,
  Latest WHERE $neodash_study_subpart = '' OR s.study_subpart_acronym = $neodash_study_subpart
RETURN
  id(s) as __id,
  TrialID,
  SubpartTrialID,
  acronym AS Acronym,
  Date,
  Version,
  Latest,
  Status order by TrialID, Latest, Date DESC , SubpartTrialID

reports.title: Filter Study
reports.query:
MATCH (sr:StudyRoot)-[r0:HAS_VERSION]->(s:StudyValue)
WITH s.study_id_prefix + '-' + s.study_number AS n
WHERE toUpper(n) CONTAINS toUpper($input)
AND ($neodash_study_subpart = '' OR EXISTS {
  MATCH (sp:StudyValue)<-[:HAS_STUDY_SUBPART]-(:StudyValue)
  WHERE sp.study_id_prefix + '-' + sp.study_number = n
  AND toUPPER(sp.study_subpart_acronym) = toUPPER($neodash_study_subpart)
})
RETURN DISTINCT n as value,  n as display ORDER BY n ASC Limit 500

reports.title: Filter subpart for - $neodash_study_number
reports.query:
MATCH (sr:StudyRoot)-[r0:HAS_VERSION]->(s:StudyValue)
WITH s, s.study_id_prefix + '-' + s.study_number AS n
WITH s, n where $neodash_study_number ='' OR n=$neodash_study_number
MATCH (s:StudyValue)<-[:HAS_STUDY_SUBPART]-(:StudyValue)
WHERE toUPPER(s.study_subpart_acronym) CONTAINS toUPPER($input) 
RETURN DISTINCT s.study_subpart_acronym as value,  s.study_subpart_acronym as display ORDER BY value ASC LIMIT 500
